summary: Lightning-fast on-device multilingual TTS — 31 languages, 10 preset voices, ~400 MB ONNX model. No GPU required; runs comfortably on CPU. Much lighter than Coqui XTTS / Qwen3-TTS at the cost of no zero-shot voice cloning from audio.
author: Subtitld add-on team

models.note: Downloaded from Hugging Face on first synthesis call. Cached under ~/.cache/supertonic3/ by default; override via SUPERTONIC_CACHE_DIR.

fields.label: Model
fields.help: Larger model = broader language coverage, longer first-run download. Switching reloads the model on the next synthesis call.

options.label: CUDA (NVIDIA GPU via onnxruntime-gpu — install separately)

fields.label: Quality (sampling steps)
fields.help: Higher = cleaner audio, slower. 5 is fastest preview, 8 is the upstream default, 12 is the quality ceiling. Past 12 the model saturates — additional steps cost compute without measurable improvement.

options.label: Auto — pass the project's language tag (recommended)
Language-agnostic (lang="na") — use when source language is uncertain

fields.label: Custom voice JSON (optional)
fields.help: Path to a Voice Builder export (https://supertonic.supertone.ai/voice_builder). When set, the addon exposes one additional voice id 'supertonic-custom' that loads this JSON instead of a preset. The 10 preset voices remain available.
